verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS productivity suite, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents a user or admin control to disable telemetry or usage tracking. The Reports API covers admins viewing usage reports, and the Meet 'Take notes for me' settings are an unrelated feature control, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
